_comment: FR24 /api/live/flight-positions/full body, built from FR24's documented FlightPositionsFull schema (fr24_id, flight, callsign, lat, lon, track, alt, gspeed, vspeed, squawk, timestamp, source, hex, type, reg, painted_as, operating_as, orig_iata, orig_icao, dest_iata, dest_icao, eta) with the values of UA2106 ORD->SFO airborne on 2026-09-27 (tail N14512, takeoff 03:17:53Z per prod). NOT a captured payload: a capture costs a paid call. No on_ground flag and no departure times exist in this schema.
